title: Cyber and Economic Warfare: Beijing's New Strategy Against Taiwan
description: A report suggests China could use non-military tactics, such as cyber warfare and economic coercion, against Taiwan. It urges the US and its allies to prepare strategies for counteraction. The study highlights potential scenarios, advising Taiwan to diversify energy imports and strengthen financial resilience.

title: Japan's 'Living in Two Worlds' Secures Sales To China, Korea, Taiwan
description: Japanese film 'Living in Two Worlds' has secured international sales to Hong Kong (Edko), China (Hugoeast) and South Korea (MediaCastle), among others.

title: Ravaging Storm: Typhoon Krathon Brings Chaos to Taiwan
description: Typhoon Krathon struck Taiwan, delivering torrential rain and gusty winds, impacting the economy and causing injuries and deaths. Schools and businesses closed in Kaohsiung as the storm flooded roads and uprooted trees. The storm was expected to weaken as it headed toward China's coast.

title: Typhoon Krathon makes landfall on Taiwan, packing fierce winds and torrential rain
description: China's weather agency said some eastern and southern parts of Taiwan are set to see extremely heavy rains of up to 40 centimeters (1.3 feet) over the next 24 hours.

title: Taiwan’s envoy asks why Canada failed to lean about China
description: In an interview with the Star on Tuesday, Taiwanese Representative Harry Ho-jen Tseng questioned how Canada didn't find more new canola customers in recent years.

title: ‘No challenges can stop China’s progress,’ Xi Jinping says in 75th anniversary speech
description: Chinese President Xi Jinping said Monday that no challenges can stop the country from moving forward and reiterated Beijing’s reunification aims with Taiwan.

title: China National Day: Xi Jinping vows ‘reunification’ with Taiwan on eve of Communist China’s 75th birthday
description: Chinese leader Xi Jinping reiterated his pledge to achieve “reunification” with Taiwan on the eve of Communist China’s 75th birthday, as Beijing flexed its military might in the run-up to the national holiday.

title: TSMC Is At Least 10 Years Ahead Of China Because Of 2nm Tech Says Minister
description: The Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) is at least a decade ahead of China believes Minister Cheng-Wen Wu.
